No tread depth gauge or close-up measurement shown; general wear varies across the stacked tires in the photos.
Inner liner/patch area not shown in any photo.
Sidewalls not shown in close-up; overall photos do not resolve small bulges or cracks.
No DOT date code or vehicle documentation visible.

risks.risk: Actual brand/origin may be generic or mismarked, not premium Belgian tire
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall showing brand name and DOT code

risks.risk: Tread depth may be lower than claimed
risks.proof: Photo or video of tread depth gauge reading on each tire
risks.if_unproven: priced at minimum legal/resale tread worst case

risks.risk: Hidden internal patch or plug repair
risks.proof: Photo of inner liner of each tire

risks.risk: Sidewall bulge or crack not visible from current angle
risks.proof: Close-up photo of full sidewall circumference per tire

risks.risk: Unclear tire size/load rating affecting value
risks.proof: Photo of sidewall size and rating text
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-fit, lowest common size assumption

risks.risk: Number of tires actually included in sale unclear
risks.proof: Photo or count confirmation of the exact tires being sold as one lot
risks.if_unproven: priced as single tire unless count confirmed

risks.risk: Rims/wheels in background may or may not be included
risks.proof: Seller statement plus photo showing tagged/matched rims with the tire lot
risks.if_unproven: priced as tires only, rims excluded

proof_requests: Close-up photo of each tire's sidewall showing brand, size, and DOT date code
Photo of tread depth gauge reading on each tire
Photo of inner liner/inside of each tire for patches
Full sidewall circumference photo per tire for bulges/cracks
Confirmation and photo of exact number of tires included
Clarification photo on whether rims are part of the sale
response.reason: Witness confirms the item as used car tires, so a worst-case price applies now; all premium claims (brand, tread %, no patch/bulge, car year) remain unverified or unverifiable remotely and would need close-up proof to raise the price.
